# Leon Builds — small-business web design and custom software

> Leon Kelvin Li is a California-based independent developer serving businesses across the United States. He builds phone-first websites, booking and ordering systems, workflow automation, AI tools, mobile apps and custom business software. Clients work directly with Leon; the written scope defines the fixed price, delivery cadence, support and handover.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-23.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://leonbuilds.org/): concise offer, inspectable public work, service paths, pricing approach and contact options.
- [Small-business web design](https://leonbuilds.org/services/websites): website scope, costs, timeline, ownership, public implementation evidence and a five-second conversion checklist.
- [Contractor Lead Recovery System](https://leonbuilds.org/missed-lead-recovery): a fixed-scope contractor website, estimate intake, acknowledgment, short follow-up and documented owner handoff; starting at $1,500.
- [Book a free 15-minute call](https://leonbuilds.org/call): weekday availability in Pacific time.
- [Get a fixed quote](https://leonbuilds.org/quote): describe the business problem in plain language.
- [All services](https://leonbuilds.org/services/): the full service catalog and published starting prices.

## Public proof you can inspect

- [Curio on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6781121127): a live consumer iOS product Leon built and shipped end to end, including client, backend, subscriptions and localization.
- [Loqol public demo](https://loqol-tds.onrender.com/agent): a guided California disclosure workflow with saved answers, consistency checks, an agent review workspace and generated PDF output. Buyer and agent signing plus seller email delivery are incomplete.
- [Loqol source](https://github.com/Noctilucenty/loqol-tds): public source for the disclosure demo.
- [The Home Screen operator prototype](https://the-home-screen.onrender.com/?b=b_bulapies): business-specific pages, menus, search and a prototype cart. Payments and kitchen operations are not live.
- [Selected work](https://leonbuilds.org/#work): screenshots, screen recording, links, role and current status for each public example.

## Core services and published starting prices

- [Small-business web design](https://leonbuilds.org/services/websites): phone-first business websites, redesigns and rescues; frontend scope from $300 and backend scope typically from $625.
- [Booking and online ordering](https://leonbuilds.org/services/booking-systems): appointments, calendars, deposits, reminders, menus and direct ordering; from $600.
- [Workflow automation](https://leonbuilds.org/services/business-automation): follow-up, document and integration workflows; from $500.
- [AI phone agents](https://leonbuilds.org/services/ai-phone-agents): routine call handling with written human-handoff rules; from $1,000.
- [AI chatbots](https://leonbuilds.org/services/ai-chatbots): assistants grounded in approved business information; from $750.
- [Dashboards and internal tools](https://leonbuilds.org/services/business-dashboards): focused operational views and task tools; from $750.
- [Custom software](https://leonbuilds.org/services/custom-software): portals, CRM, inventory and business-specific systems; from $1,500.
- [Mobile apps](https://leonbuilds.org/services/mobile-apps): iOS and Android product development through store submission; from $3,500.
- [SEO and AI search](https://leonbuilds.org/services/seo): technical search foundations and answer-ready content structure; from $300.

Every amount above is a starting point, not a quote. Additions are priced and approved before they begin. Only the source, accounts, data, documentation and support named in the written scope are included; third-party providers and licensed components keep their own terms.
